༄༅/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i sgrub thabs nges don thig le bzhugs so/ /༈/na maḥs manta bha dra ya/dpal ldan rtsa ba'i sogs/kun tu bzang po rdo rje sems

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rdo rje gzhon nu'i sgrub thabs nges don thig le bzhugs so// ༈ /na maḥs manta bha dra ya/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i

sogs/ kun tu bzang po rdo rje sems dpa'i dpal// padma 'byung gnas klu yi dbang po dang*// rdo rje rin chen shes rab rin chen dang*// tshul khrims rgyal po rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rdo rje gtsug tor dge skyabs dge mthong dang*// 'khon ston bal po shakyā blo gros mtshan// shes rab tshul khrims dkon mchog rgyal po'i zhabs// kun dga' snying po rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bsod nams rtse mo grags pa rgyal mtshan dang*// sa skya paṇa chen 'phags pa rin po che// 'od ldan dpal dang kun dga' rdo rje dang*// legs pa'i blo gros rnams la gsol ba 'debs// kun dga' bsod nams rin chen rgyal mtshan dang*// bla ma dam pa dpal ldan tshul khrims pa// ngor chen rdo rje 'chang dang grags pa'i zhabs// glo bo mkhan chen rnams la gsol ba 'debs// sa skya lo tsā sngags 'chang chen po dang*// bsod nams dbang po 'jam mgon a me'i zhabs// bsod nams dbang phyug kun dga' bkris dang*// bsod nams rin chen rnams la gsol ba 'debs// sa chen kun blo dbang sdud snying po dang*// padma bdud 'dul dbang phyug maṅga la// kun dga' snying po karma ratna dang*// kun dga' rin chen rnams la gsol ba 'debs// blo gros snying po gzhan phan snying po dang*// ngag dbang kun dga' bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal// bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// rnam gsum ting nge 'dzin la legs gnas nas// dkyil 'khor gsum bsgom mchod pa gsum gyis mchod// dri ma gsum sbyangs sku gsum mngon gyur te// sa gsum skye dgu'i dpal du bdag gyur cig /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang*// 'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing*// sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas// rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog// / ༄༅// na mo badzra kī la ya/ 'od gsal dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo'i sku// bla ma rdo rje gzhon nu la// btud nas de yi sgrub thabs bri// bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yi// sgrub thabs shin tu bsdus pa ni// 'khrul zad sngags 'chang yab sras kyi// phyag len mdzad pa 'di ltar ro//

sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gi bsnyen sgrub bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / lan gsum/ sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig byams pa/ /sdug bsngal dag dang bral bar shog snying rje/ /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*/ dga' ba/ /chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog btang snyoms/ oṃ mahā shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ oṃ ni sngags kyi mgo 'dren pa/ nye tshe ba ma yin pa'i stong pa chen po/ ye shes rang gi sems/ rdo rje de'i ngang du gnas pas rang bzhin/ bdag nyid nga'o// de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin/ oṃ dharmā dhā tu badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ chos rnams kyi dbyings rdo rje bdag nyid can gyi rang bzhin de nga'o// rdo rje chos nyid don gyi rdo rje de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin/ khro bos zhe sdang gcod/ mtshan ma dang rnam rtog la 'phros pas zhe sdang gtso bor gyur pa'i nyon mongs gcod pa kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ /mtshon chen sngon po cher 'bar ba/ /nam mkha'i dkyil du thig le shar/ ye shes lnga mtshon pa'i hūm̐ sngon po 'od zer 'bar ba rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin/ /srog gi sgo ru shar ba dang*/ 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i bskyed gzhir shar ba/ /snying gi dkyil du bsgom par bya/ hūm̐ rjes su mar babs nas snying gar sems dpa' gsum brtseg bsgom/ /hūm̐ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ spha ra ṇa phaṭa// hūm̐ las raṃ chad snod bcud 'jig rten bsreg /yaṃ spros pas rlung gis gtor// khaṃ spros pas chus bkrus// skyon thams cad dag par byas// e yaṃ waṃ raṃ laṃ raṃ keṃ e spha ra phaṭa// hūm̐ las yi ge de dag 'phros pas rten gyi dkyil 'khor du 'gyur// e las mkha' dbyings dag pa nam mkha'i dkyil/

gru gsum mthing skya/ /yaṃ las rlung chen rgya gram sra zhing brtan/ zlum po ljang gu zur nas bltas na gzhu 'dra ba/ /de steng waṃ las byung ba'i chu dkyil dkar/ dkar po zlum po/ /raṃ las me byung bskyod pa de yi phyed/ gru gsum dmar po/ /laṃ las sa yi dkyil 'khor brtan par gyur/ gru bzhi ser po/ /de steng rakta'i rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrug raṃ las khrag gi rgya mtsho/ /dbus su keng rus ri rab brtsegs pa'i steng*/ keng las keng rus kyi ri rab/ gru gsum mthing nag mu khyud rdo rjes spras/ e las chos 'byung*/ dzaḥpaṃ padma maṇḍa la/ ma sūrya maṇḍa la/ a tsand+ra maṇḍa la/ mahā de wa dzaḥ u ma de wī dzaḥ padma nyi ma zla ba/ dbang phyug pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan gyi g.yas su dbang phyug kha sbubs/ g.yon du u ma gan rgyal/ gyi steng du/ rgyu yi ting nge 'dzin gyi hūm̐ de babs pa las 'od 'phros don gnyis sangs rgyas byang sems rnams mchod pa dang*/ sems can gyi sgrib pa sbyangs pa sogs/ byas tshur gzhi'i hūm̐ la/ 'dus te 'od du zhu nas rang rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur gyur pa ni/ hūm̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ oṃ badzra kī li kī li ya sarba bighnān bhandha hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ hūm̐/ gdan steng bdag nyid khro bo'i rgyal// bcom ldan rdo rje dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje'o/ /skye 'chi bgres rgud med pas gzhon nu'i sku// mthing nag zhal gsum sku gsum mtshon/ phyag drug pa/ phar phyin drug mtshon/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal// rdo rje rtse dgu ye shes dgus sa dgu man gyi rtog sgrib sbyong ba/ rtse lnga dang*/ 'gro ba'i sgrib pa sbyong zhing sku lnga ye shes lnga la sbyor ba/ 'khor ba'i nyon mongs bsregs pas /me dpung 'bar ba dug gsum bcad nas sku gsum la sbyor bas/

rtse gsum rnams// g.yas g.yon gnyis gnyis phyag gis bsnams// thabs shes gnyis med sgo nas dgra bgegs la gzir bas/ mtha' gnyis phur 'dril sku che rags// skye gnas bzhi sbyang phyir /mche ba bzhi gtsigs spyan gsum zlum zhing dmar/ g.yas kyi spyan gsum chos dbyings la gzigs pa/ g.yon gyi spyan gsum sems can la gzigs pa/ dbus kyi spyan gsum 'khor 'das mnyam nyid la gzigs pa'o/ /log lta'i 'gro ba dbyings su 'dren pas /ral pa kham pa gyen du brdzes/ gti mug can 'dul ba dang stobs bcu rdzogs pa'i rtags /glang lpags 'dod chags can 'dul ba dang tshul khrims rnam par dag pa'i rtags zhing chen g.yang gzhi gsol// zhe sdang can sogs 'dul dka' ba 'dul ba la mchog tu dpa' ba'i rtags/ stag gi pags pa'i 'og pags can// klu rigs bzhi dbang du sdud pa dang 'phrin las bzhi mthar phyin pa'i rtags su sbrul dkar khras dbu rgyan/ dmar khras mgul rgyan/ ljang khras rked bcing*/ nag khras phyag zhabs dpung pa rnams brgyan pa dkar dmar ljang nag sbrul gyis brgyan// dbu rgyan se ral rked bcings dang*// phyag dang zhabs rnams rnam par spras// chos sku skyon dang bral ba'i rtags thod skam lnga yis dbu la rgyan/ rigs lnga mtshon/ / dregs pa zil gyis gnon pa'i rtags rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas// rakta zhag dang thal chen gyi// thig le zo ris tshom bu bris/ pa ste/ thugs rjes sems can la chags pa'i rtags mkhur tshos g.yas g.yon la/ rakta ste khrag gi thig le/ don dam bcud kyi brgyan pa'i rtags nu ma gnyis bar zhag gi zo ris zla ba phyed pa dang 'dra ba dang*/ mtshan ma'i spros pa med pa'i rtags su skra mtshams su thal chen gyi tshom bu bris/ /sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ gser la sogs pa rin po che'i dbu rgyan/

snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ phyag zhabs mdzes par spras pa'o// bsdu dngos bzhi mtshon pas zhabs bzhi/ /zhabs bzhi g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs nas// dbang phyug kha sbub mgo bo dang*// u ma'i nu ma rab tu brdzis// ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ zhabs g.yas gnyis bskum pas dbang phyug kha sbub tu yod pa'i mgo bo brdzis pas rtag pa'i mtha' mnan pa/ g.yon gnyis brkyangs nas chad pa'i mtha' mnan pa'i phyir u ma gan rgyal du yod pa'i nu ma'i steng brdzis pa/ sprul pa du ma 'gyed pa'i rtags su sma ra ag tshom me ltar 'bar ba/ ljags dmar po glog ltar 'khyug pa/ snyan dang shangs nas dus kyi 'thor rlung 'brug stong dus gcig tu ldir ba ltar sgrog zhal nam mkha' ltar gdangs pa/ thabs shes rab kyi rang bzhin rdo rje khyung gshog nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa/ /rang gi phung po khams dang skye mched skra// nyi khri chig stong ba spu bye ba phrag /phyed dang bzhi la sogs pa thams cad kyang*// rdo rje gzhon nu rang dang 'dra bas go mtshams med pas gtams par gyur/ / chos la dmigs pa'i snying rjes rang tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog las bsgral te bdag dang lha'i skur bskyed/ ba'i dam tshig ni/ lha bsgom pa las mi 'da' ba'o // nga rgyal gyis bsad zhe sdang gis bcings gti mug gis mnan pa nyid min te// phung po rdo rje'i bdag nyid de phung khams skye mched lha'i bdag nyid du bsgom // rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom/ thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' bsgom pa ste/ thugs kar gzhal yas khang zlum po sgo gcig pa/ sgo srung rta mgrin yum bzhi dang bcas/ nang du nyi gdan la ye shes sems dpa' rang dang 'dra ba'i tshogs rgyal ba'i thugs ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba bsgom/ bhrūm̐ bi ma na mahā sūrya dzñā na sa twa kṛṣṇa shu ka pañtsa badzra hūm̐/

oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān bhandha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dipta tsakra ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sngo dbyings las ma g.yos pas sngo sang*// chos kun ro gcig pas zhal gcig bden pa gnyis mtshon pas phyag gnyis g.yas 'khor lo/ gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu gnyis/ /g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stobs// thugs rje glog ltar myur ba'i rtags gzig gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ /rus pa'i rgyan lngas dbu la brgyan// thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan// skam po lnga bcus do shal byas/ sbrul dang rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan// rakta zhag dang thal chen gyi// thig le zo ris tshom bur byas// thabs shes kyi rang bzhin zhabs gnyis g.yas zhabs g.yas thugs rje chen pos sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i rtags su brkyang pa/ g.yon brkyangs bskum gyis/ g.yon shes rab rtogs pa'i brdar bskum pa/ /yab kyi g.yon nas 'khyud par bzhugs// rdo rje gzhon nu rig 'dzin rnams// 'khor ba rdo rje grub par mdzod// oṃ spha ra na phaṭa/ 'od zer phar 'phros/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ tshur bsdus rang la thim pas snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas khang du gyur/ 'khor ba rdo rje phur pa'i lha// ye shes khro bo grub par mdzod/ /oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra sa ma dzaḥ sa ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ oṃ badzra yakṣi ni hūm̐ dzaḥ sa gnod sbyin mo mdog dkar pu shud mgo can lcags skyu dang phur pa thogs pas ye shes pa rnams smin mtshams su 'gugs/ oṃ badzra bhai ra be hūm̐ hūm̐/ gis 'jigs byed ma ser mo bya rog mgo can zhags pa dang phur bu thogs pas ye shes pa rnams rang la zhugs/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta hūm̐ baṃ/ gyis bdud rtsi ma mdog dmar srin bya'i mgo can lcags sgrogs dang phur bu thogs pas dbyer med du byas/

oṃ badzra ma ra ṇi hūm̐ hoḥ sa gsod byed ma ljang gu khwa'i mgo can dril bu dang phur bu thogs pas dam tshig pa rnams ye shes pa'i ngo bor byas par bsam mo// rang gi gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ bsam pa de la sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs bstims nas byin gyis brlabs par bsam la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku// rdo rje de nyid rang bzhin las// chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid// 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa// sku yi gter du bdag bskyed cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes gsung*// rdo rje de nyid rang bzhin las// chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid// 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa// gsung gi gter du bdag skyed cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wā ka badzra swa bha wa ātma ko3haṃ// sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes thugs// rdo rje de nyid rang bzhin las// chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid// 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa// thugs kyi gter du bdag skyed cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros dbang lha khro bo rigs lnga spyan drangs/ thabs kyi spyod pas sems can don// byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba// sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs par mdzod// dbang dang byin rlabs 'dir stsol cig / dbu gtsug tu rigs lnga'i khro bos dbur brgyan/ oṃ badzra shrī he ru ka badzra kro dhī shwa ri hūm̐/ oṃ buddha shrī he ru ka buddha kro dhī shwa ri oṃ/ oṃ ratna shrī he ru ka ratna kro dhī shwa ri trām̐/ oṃ padma shrī he ru ka padma kro dhī shwa ri hrīḥ oṃ karma shrī he ru ka karma kro dhī shwa ri aḥ dbang bskur bas/ hūm̐ badzra dzñā na kī li kī la ya dzñā na sa twa e tri kro nā bi ma naḥ paṃ padma maṇḍa la/ ma sūrya maṇḍa la/

a tsand+ra maṇḍa la/ hūm̐ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān bhandha hūm̐ phaṭa/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du// dbang phyug u ma bsnol ba'i gdan steng na// bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu ni// sku mdog mthing nag 'jigs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan// yab yum thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med// 'khor gyi phra men pho nya'i tshogs la sogs// yun ring dus nas bsnyen cing bsgrub pa'i lha// drag po rang 'byung dbang dang dngos grub stsol// oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighā nan bhandha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ji ltar rigs pa bzlas pa'i mthar/ oṃ dipta tsakra ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes ci rigs dang*/ mahā rakmoḥ yakmoḥ kā la ru pa/ snying rtsa la yaṃ yaṃḥ srog rtsa la yaṃ yaṃḥ snying la khril khrilaḥ srog la chum chum/ tsitta srog la tuṃ tuṃ/ thum ril ril/ snying khrag srog la shan shānaḥ snying tsheg tshegaḥ 'ur 'uraḥ shig shigaḥ gul gulaḥ nyag nyagaḥ gsod gsodaḥ dha ti ma ma shrī ghaṃ karma ka ra ma ra se na pra mar dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mdun gyi ye shes sems dpa' 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rang nyid bkrag mdangs gzi brjid nus mthu phun sum tshogs par gyur/ lha tshogs 'khor bcas ma lus kun// sngon gyi dam tshig rjes dgongs la// gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba dang*// kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol// ye shes lnga ldan rigs lnga bde bar gshegs// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi// 'khor lo rab bskor zhi khro'i skur bstan pa// thugs dam dbang gis bdag la rtser dgongs nas// drag po'i stobs kyis dgra bgegs bsgral ba dang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol//

he ru ka'i yig brgya tshar gsum/ oṃ shrī badzra ku mā ra kro dha rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra ka wa tsi hūm̐ phaṭa/ dge ba 'di yis mtha' yas sems can kun// bdud las rnam rgyal bar chad kun bcom nas// rdo rje gzhon nu mya ngan 'das pa yi// 'bras bu byang chub nges par 'grub gyur cig /skye med chos sku rang bzhin rnam dag las// thugs dam dbang gis gzugs kyi skur sprul pa// bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi// skye 'chi med pa don gyi bkra shis shog / ces dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i sgrub thabs shin tu bsdus pa sa lo sngags 'chang yab sras kyi dgongs pa 'khrul med 'di sa skya pa kun blos yon tan rgya mtsho'i don du bris pa dge'o// sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
